correctness.rationale: Every simple cycle in the open two-row ladder is uniquely the rectangle between two rungs. Direct endpoint-equality and gap-interval formulas prove precisely the \(n+3\) forbidden edge pairs and rule out every triple. Exact edge count yields the polynomial; independent binary searches on disjoint endpoint ranges and the number-of-concepts bound yield matching ranks on powers of two, while an eight-leaf certificate proves the \(n=5\) boundary. A separately implemented graph-cycle enumerator validated 6,910 supports for \(2\le n\le9\), exact online dimensions for \(2\le n\le12\) and every certificate leaf. The finite checks do not replace the uniform proof.

value.rationale: The result completely classifies every shattered physical-edge support of an infinite, natural cycle-hypergraph family and isolates the exceptional twin rail coordinates. More strongly it supplies a uniform, two-vertex-connected planar graph family of maximum degree three with static VC dimension two but an unbounded logarithmic online dimension, first separating at five columns and known exactly on an infinite dyadic subsequence. This is motivated structural content beyond finite enumeration or a standalone elementary inequality.
